title: out_algo label on SYMMETRIC KEY fd not enforced — key usable with any algo
description: DO_KDF stores op.out_algo as state->key_algo (a label), but ioctl_init's key_fd path (fd.c:630-670) does not check that the SYMMETRIC KEY fd's key_algo matches op.algo. A key derived with out_algo='cbc(aes)' can be used to init a 'gcm(aes)' session, or vice versa. The UAPI doc says out_algo 'Determines the KEY fd's algo label and the provider used to wrap the derived key bytes' — but there is no wrapping and no enforcement. This violates key separation (using the same key material for two different algorithms), which is a FIPS 140-3 / SP 800-57 concern. Maintenance consequence: users will assume the label is enforced (it sounds like it is), then file issues when cross-algo use works silently. Fix: in ioctl_init key_fd path, reject if ks->key_algo \!= op.algo.
